A young [[Gender/Legends|woman]] on [[Kabaira]] joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]] against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Passages">{{JournalCite|7|Passages}}</ref>

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
This Rebel first appeared in "[[Passages]]," a short story written by [[Charlene Newcomb]] and published in [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 7|''Star Wars Adventure Journal'' 7]] in August [[1995]].<ref name="Passages" />
